The '''Twi'lek Pilgrims''' were a group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] who fled the oppressive conditions of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and various other colony worlds during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
An organization founded during the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]], the first [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]], [[Kolovish]], began to attract followers to her cause when she was a worker in a refugee camp catering to those displaced by the occupation of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] homeworld, [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]]. Kolovish preached to her small group of followers about a simple life, espousing the tenets of an ancient code she had uncovered on a distant world. Gathering a larger following as she moved from refugee camps across the region, Kolovish and her wandering band of pilgrims fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] after constantly being rebuffed by other host planets until they came upon the recently reoccupied planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="TOR" />

Landing on the lush forested world, the pilgrims came into contact with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which had just recently resettled the planet in secret. Building the Matriarch's home over the area of the first craft's landing, the pilgrims petitioned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to legalize the settlement but were denied. Ignoring the illegality of their settlement, the Twi'leks continued to strive to build permanent structures despite assaults by the local [[Flesh Raider]]s and the refusal of the neighboring Jedi to assist.<ref name="TOR" />
